meta.title: InterviewDE - AI-Empowered Interview Training for Germany

footer.tagline: AI-empowered mock interviews for internships and jobs in Germany. Cutting-edge LLMs, premium voice tech, bespoke questions, and real-time feedback—so you show up prepared.
footer.powered: AI-empowered · Latest models & voice · Built for Germany-bound talent

landing.badge: Built for interns & Werkstudent roles in Germany
landing.sub: Built on state-of-the-art large language models and advanced speech: bespoke interview questions for your role, natural voice dialogue, and live evaluation as you answer. Train in German or English and own your Bewerbungsgespräch.
landing.coachBannerTitle: AI resume deep-dive on your Profile
landing.coachBannerSub: Scores by dimension, section-level rewrites, and a prioritized checklist—optionally tuned to a target role. Same career context as mock interviews. Sign in and open Profile to generate a report.
landing.coachPreviewAria: Sample resume coach: scores and checklist
landing.coachPreviewLine1: Top fix: quantify outcomes with metrics—avoid duty-only bullets.
landing.coachPreviewLine2: Work: add stack + business context for sharper German tech interviews.
landing.heroStackBullet1: Strengths: tie highlights to the target role—fewer generic intros, more verifiable wins.
landing.heroStackBullet2: Experience: add stack, business context, and metrics so recruiters can judge fit quickly.

features.f1d: Your job description drives the session—technical and behavioural depth tailored to you, not generic question banks.
features.f2d: Full interviews in German or English — authentic context for German employers, powered by modern dialogue models.
features.f3d: Speak naturally; premium text-to-speech delivers the interviewer’s lines—train pace, clarity, and confidence under fire.
features.f4d: 5/10/15/20 minutes — quick drills or full mock sessions.
features.f5d: From wording and impact to structure and ATS-friendly keywords—actionable section fixes and a ranked to-do list. Add a target role for tighter positioning in Germany/EU. One click on Profile.

landing.featuresSub: From JD intelligence to live dialogue and instant critique—latest AI plus real interview craft, end to end.
landing.howSub: From your JD to voice practice in the browser—multi-agent flow, neural audio, and feedback that keeps pace with you.
landing.howMainTitle: Smart routing from setup to dialogue
landing.howMainB1: Latest models read your role and JD to steer domains, competencies, and question depth—personalised, not one-size-fits-all.
landing.howMainB2: Opening → technical depth → behavioural STAR → closing feedback—multi-agent orchestration like a real panel.

steps.d1: Job title and description from the company website
steps.d3: An AI-empowered interviewer probes in real time—you answer by voice or text

landing.testimonialsSub: From people preparing internships, Werkstudent roles, and grad hiring in Germany—how practice, voice, and resume coaching helped.
landing.testimonial1Body: I used to freeze on long German answers. After a few JD-driven sessions here I could finally walk through projects with STAR in the real interview. Voice mode feels nothing like typing to a bot.
landing.testimonial2Body: Pasting the official job description made the follow-ups surprisingly on-target. The resume report flagged bullets where I never quantified impact—fixing those changed how recruiters responded.
landing.testimonial3Body: I rotated English and German runs; 10-minute slots fit between lectures. Having history on the dashboard made my pre-interview week feel structured instead of chaotic.
landing.ctaEndTitle: Your next German offer starts here
landing.ctaEndSub: Free to use, no credit card. Same stack: frontier models, neural voice, tailored drills, live critique.

profile.title: Profile & resume
profile.sub: Save a default resume here so you do not need to upload every time; the setup page can still override per session.
profile.placeholder: Paste your resume or upload a PDF and edit here…
profile.parseErr: Parse failed—try another file or paste manually.
profile.hint: Scanned PDFs may yield no text; use a text-based PDF or paste content. Saved text is used in mock interviews together with role and JD.
profile.sectionNotes: Notes (appended to generated resume text for interviews)
profile.footerHint: Saved text is used as resume context in mock interviews.
profile.coachSub: Emphasizes STAR (Situation, Task, Action, Result) for work experience and projects; skills lists usually need little change. Adds macro feedback—richness, project–role fit, evidence at a glance. Uses the interview resume text (or last saved); never invents jobs or projects.
profile.coachFallbackHint: We use the interview resume text (≈80+ chars). Copy PDF extract there or paste manually. If empty, your last saved resume text is used.
profile.coach503: Server has no GEMINI_API_KEY; resume coach is unavailable.
profile.coachMacroSub: Whole-document view: density, how well projects and roles match your target, whether impact reads quickly—not micro-formatting.
profile.coachSectionsStar: Prioritizes work and projects: STAR-style context, actions, and verifiable results; usually not a full rewrite of skills keywords alone.
profile.coachPersistNote: Report saved to your account ({{time}}); it stays after refresh.
profile.displaySub: Saved structured information and resume text. Use Edit profile to upload PDFs, run AI fill, or change anything.
profile.coachEditHint: To regenerate the coach report or change the target role, go to the edit page.
profile.viewImportHint: PDF upload, text extraction, and AI parsing are available in Edit profile.

cv.pageSub: Structured profile first. After PDF upload, text stays in a pending area—open “View extracted text”, then optionally apply it to the interview resume or run “AI fill profile”.

cv.extractErr: Could not parse. Try again or edit manually.
cv.extractNeedText: Need ~80+ characters of resume text: upload a PDF and preview, or expand “Interview resume text” and paste.
cv.pdfExtractOk: Extracted about {{n}} characters from PDF. Use “View extracted text” to inspect.
cv.extractedPreviewLabel: Raw text from the last PDF extract (not auto-applied)
cv.appliedResumeOk: Copied into interview resume text—remember to save.
cv.emptySection: No entries yet—add manually or use AI fill.
cv.rawResumeHint: Mock interviews and resume coach use this plain text. After PDF upload, copy extracted text here with the button above, then save.
cv.saveFooter: Saves structured data to your account; interview text powers AI questions.

questions.text: I maintain uncompromising standards for the quality of my output and am deeply committed to achieving excellence in execution.
I find that I can naturally guide others through a blend of logic and passion, earning their authentic buy-in for my ideas.
I possess a keen emotional acuity that allows me to sense subtle shifts in others' moods and build profound empathy.
I habitually look beyond immediate constraints to systematically explore potential scenarios and long-term strategic blueprints.
Once a goal is set, I demonstrate immense perseverance, refusing to relent until the objective is fully realized.
In complex or ambiguous situations, I instinctively take command to provide clarity and direction for the team.
I believe that team cohesion is the cornerstone of success and strive to cultivate an inclusive, highly collaborative environment.
I am energized by deconstructing complex information to uncover the underlying patterns hidden within data.
I excel at architecting efficient workflows, optimizing resource allocation to ensure every component operates at peak performance.
In public forums or social interactions, I consistently elevate the atmosphere and transform engagement into tangible opportunity.
I am naturally inclined to invest in others' growth, finding profound fulfillment in seeing their potential unlocked.
When faced with challenges, I frequently propose unconventional ideas and visionary solutions that disrupt traditional thinking.
I view commitment as a core value, upholding my responsibilities with unwavering integrity even under significant external pressure.
I am adept at communicating a compelling vision at scale, inspiring broad audiences to take decisive action.
I possess exceptional conflict-resolution skills, finding the equilibrium among diverse interests to drive consensus.
Before initiating action, I conduct comprehensive risk assessments and meticulous planning to ensure a successful outcome.
I am driven by an internal competitive fire to constantly surpass my own limits and reject mediocrity in all forms.
I thrive in competitive environments, viewing victory as a vital benchmark for validating my personal capabilities.
I place immense value on long-term partnerships built on deep trust rather than temporary interactions based on short-term gain.
I have an insatiable intellectual curiosity, constantly seeking to integrate knowledge from diverse and unfamiliar domains.
